summary: Frontend-only testing for Light Mode Overhaul and Map Marker Redesign. All light mode features verified working correctly. Theme toggle via Settings > Appearance works properly. All pages render correctly in both light and dark modes.

light_mode_settings.test_result: PASSED - Settings > Appearance section shows theme toggle with Dark/Light options
light_mode_settings.details: Light theme button has data-testid='theme-light-btn', Dark has data-testid='theme-dark-btn'

light_mode_dashboard.test_result: PASSED - Dashboard renders with white cards, dark text (#111111), light gray background (#f5f5f7)

light_mode_pipeline.test_result: PASSED - Pipeline page renders correctly with light theme colors

light_mode_contacts.test_result: PASSED - Contacts page renders with proper light mode styling

light_mode_team.test_result: PASSED - Team page renders correctly in light mode

light_mode_calendar.test_result: PASSED - Calendar page with FullCalendar renders correctly in light mode

light_mode_portals.test_result: PASSED - Portals page renders correctly in light mode

light_mode_map.test_result: PASSED - Map page renders correctly in light mode

dark_mode_regression.test_result: PASSED - Dark mode still works correctly after light mode changes
dark_mode_regression.details: Verified Dashboard, Pipeline, Calendar, Map all render correctly in dark mode

map_markers_redesign.test_result: VERIFIED - DealMarker component redesigned as clean minimalistic dots
map_markers_redesign.details: Core dot: 16px diameter, circular, 2.5px white border. Outer ring: 24px with subtle breathing animation. No building icons.

theme_persistence.test_result: PASSED - Theme preference persists in localStorage as 'dl-theme'

css_global_overrides.test_result: VERIFIED - index.css contains ~100 lines of [data-theme='light'] CSS overrides
css_global_overrides.details: Catches inline styles for colors, backgrounds, borders, inputs, scrollbars

critical_code_review_comments: designSystem.js: Well-structured light/dark color palettes with getThemeColors, getThemeShadows, getThemeGradients helpers
index.css: Comprehensive [data-theme='light'] CSS overrides catch hardcoded inline dark styles globally
App.css: FullCalendar-specific and table-specific light mode overrides at bottom of file
ThemeContext.js: Clean implementation using localStorage and data-theme attribute on html element
MapView.js DealMarker: Clean minimalistic dot design with subtle breathing animation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light mode overhaul complete. Theme toggle works via Settings > Appearance. All pages (Dashboard, Pipeline, Contacts, Team, Calendar, Portals, Map, Settings) properly support both dark and light themes. Map markers redesigned as clean minimalistic dots (16px core with 2.5px white border, 24px outer ring with breathing animation). CSS overrides in index.css and App.css catch hardcoded inline dark styles. Theme persists in localStorage as 'dl-theme'.
